definitions.explanation: The ability to control one's emotions, impulses, and desires. A valued personal quality in both personal and professional settings.

examples.japanese: {自制心|じせいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a person with strong self-control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|おこ}り→怒る：00876_okoru⟧そうになった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{自制心|じせいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}った→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: I was about to get angry, but I maintained my self-control.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自制心|じせいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{試|ため}される→試す：02130_tamesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧しまう。
examples.english: While on a diet, your self-control is tested, but I lose when I see sweets.

notes:
USAGE:
Often discussed in the context of personal development, education, and emotional management. A lack of {自制心|じせいしん} is seen as a character flaw.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自制心|じせいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (to have strong self-control)
- {自制心|じせいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (to maintain self-control)
- {自制心|じせいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose self-control)
- {自制心|じせいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (self-control kicks in)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忍耐力|にんたいりょく}→忍耐力：19989_nintairyoku⟧: perseverance; endurance — focuses on tolerating hardship over time
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧: patience; endurance — more everyday term for holding back or tolerating something
